name: Calibre Server
description: OPDS content server for ebooks — search, browse, and download from your Calibre library
author: Crow

env_vars.name: CALIBRE_LIBRARY_PATH
env_vars.description: Host path to your Calibre library folder

env_vars.name: CALIBRE_USERNAME
env_vars.description: Calibre login username (Crow creates `admin` at install and writes it here; leave it as `admin`)

env_vars.name: CALIBRE_PASSWORD
env_vars.description: Calibre login password. Crow generates it at install and keeps it in Settings → Passwords.

notes: Self-host via Docker (set CALIBRE_LIBRARY_PATH) or connect to an existing Calibre content server (set CALIBRE_URL). The bundle runs the content server itself with a login required — the desktop app over a web browser is gone — and Crow creates its `admin` account at install, keeping the password in Settings → Passwords. An install that already had content-server users keeps them.
